title: Ordinary connection headroom
summary: Reserved and superuser-reserved slots reduce ordinary admission capacity. A privileged probe can connect while ordinary clients cannot. Server admission headroom does not measure an application driver pool.
checks: Compare ordinary-slot estimate with explicit minimum and application checkout evidence.
limitations: Estimate includes the probe connection; role limits and races remain unmeasured.
applicability: PostgreSQL 14–18 collectors; reserved setting capability checked
